PM Modi Inaugurates Port Projects Worth Over ₹1200 Crore

Prime Minister Modi inaugurated and laid the foundation for port projects totaling ₹753.68 crore at VOC Port and ₹482 crore at Kamarajar Port. The projects at VOC Port aim to boost container capacity, green energy, mobility, and infrastructure. The initiatives at Kamarajar Port include the inauguration of a coal berth and the foundation laying for cargo berth modernization.
